raw_text: India Dismisses Chinese Media Claims About COVID Origins Based on Sewage Studies. India's health ministry has categorically rejected claims by Chinese state media outlets Global Times and CGTN suggesting COVID-19 may have originated in India. The ministry pointed out that the cited preprint studies have been retracted or debunked by the scientific community. External affairs ministry called it a coordinated disinformation campaign designed to deflect scrutiny from China's handling of the pandemic.
clean_text: India rejects Chinese state media claims about COVID origins from sewage studies. Cited preprint studies retracted or debunked. External affairs ministry calls it coordinated disinformation to deflect pandemic scrutiny from China.
